posts.body_html:
looks like we missed august, but at least on this side, there wasn't much to see, relatively speaking. It's almost mid September ( it's Sept 13th today) and the leucophyllas are still 1-2 weeks away from opening up, they're pretty late this year I guess?

some updated pics of the collection, taken 9/1/23!




Yes, in the center of the photo, those flavas are S. flava var. rubricorpora GIANT (back row giant x burgundy), these were all "atropurpurea" selections that had unusually dark bodies. To my surprise, back row giant has some really dark genes up in there! in the fore-ground-ish are some atropurpurea crosses (left) and atropurpureas from Okaloosa Co, FL (right, barely shown):
